provenance_note: A local reduction of the producer's preserved graph run manifests. Not a publisher attachment: the dashboard re-verifies its association with the immutable candidate manifest and the published build evidence on every request.
label_basis: Stage names are plain renderings of the native node ids, which are shown alongside them. Groups are taken from the text before the first dot in each id.

coverage.reason: The preserved run manifests record typed artifact inputs and outputs receipt by receipt, not the compiled structural declaration of the graph. Column-level data flow, population-version and base relationships, source edges, the canonical order and column ownership are all part of the compiled graph and none of them are serialized into a run manifest. A receipt that declares no typed artifact therefore cannot be connected to any other, so this is a partial view of the run.

source_field_allowlist: nodes.*.receipt.summary (selected aggregate counts and weighted shares)
content_key_note: One content key identifies the computation and its outputs. It is taken over the node payloads with the run-level fields removed — whether each node was a cache hit, and how long it took — so two executions of the same computation share it and it does not identify an execution. The executions below are told apart by the byte digest of each recorded run manifest.

executions.label: Cold run
executions.description: The graph run recorded with an empty result cache for the geography phase.

executions.label: Required replay
executions.description: The cache-only replay the producer required after the cold run, recorded under the build-evidence mode `resume`.
